commit.message:
fix: confirm Memory storage and exclude unverified ASR from skill reports

Refresh the actual preferences backend before Memory round/statistics readback, including recovery through newly opened adapters. Preserve committed-write recovery and existing owner, rule, reward and storage keys.

Build parent reports and daily recommendations from existing learning SkillRecords without interpreting unconfirmed speech-recognition summaries as reading competence. Preserve summary records and public callers.

Add 14 cache/platform durability contracts and 10 reading-evidence boundary contracts. Independent source review completed; actual CI execution remains required.
